body:
I had obtained this chemical as a free sample with a larger order of another RC. I was hoping to get a chemical similar to methylone, but I was disappointed after I found it had zero similarity to M1. It did have very unique effects to any serotonin drug I've ever taken however, and that was somewhat interesting. I have great experience with stimulants and empathogens, and some tolerance.
[0:00] It is 12:00 AM and I unwrapped my supply and railed 75mg in each nostril. I lay down in bed and watch TV, waiting for this to kick in.
[0:10] I suddenly feel tired. My mind seems awake and alert but my body feels heavy and out of energy. I have a hard time keeping my eyes open, so I close my eyes and listen to the TV.
[0:15] I feel perfectly normal again, it's as if I never took anything...
[0:25] I decide that the drug isn't going anywhere, so I rail 50mg more in each nostril.
[0:35] I feel just like I did before, tired and heavy. I close my eyes and notice I am mildly hallucinating and getting these excerpts from my day played back to me like a recorded movie.
[0:45] The effect has ended again. Something is happening, I mildly hallucinated and got what I've heard are called 'brain movies'.
[0:55] I feel perfectly sober with an elevated heart rate and pulse, with no eye dilation. I decide to rail 125mg in each nostril to see if I can really get somewhere tonight...
[1:00] I noticed a bizarre rush of tiredness and warmness. It was very much like an MDMA rush without the stimulation, euphoria, or the other enjoyable parts. I sank back into my bed and closed my eyes.
[1:05] It feels like I'm lucid dreaming, I get these ghostly visuals where I'm walking down the hallways at my college and it's very clear. I hear the TV outside my body, and I feel my bed under me;  but when my eyes are closed I see a very vivid CEV of my college campus.
[1:15] I am sober again. It is about 1:20 AM and I am going to try to sleep.
[~4:00] I fell asleep about 3 hours after the last dose.
